jojo_ripples.skill.highway_star_room.des: Place an illusion on a wall within 32 blocks. It takes the first entrant's scent, then releases eight soles. Costs 300 stamina; 30-second cooldown.
jojo_ripples.skill.highway_star_room.con: Aim at a wall to place. Hold %s and click the room slot to dismiss it.

action.highwaystar.condition.room_player: Only players can place this room
action.highwaystar.condition.room_needs_: Aim at a wall with two clear blocks in front
highwaystar.configuration.room.expiryEna: On: an Illusory Room nobody has entered disappears after the lifetime below, even while its chunk is unloaded. Off: unused rooms never expire by time.
highwaystar.configuration.room.expiryTic: Age, in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second), at which an unused Illusory Room disappears. 12000 ticks is 10 minutes. Only used while Room expires is on.
action.highwaystar.condition.cannot_remo: Cannot control remotely in split form
highwaystar.configuration.highwaystar.dr: Damage dealt per second by each attached sole.
highwaystar.configuration.highwaystar.fe: Health restored to the user per sole per second.
Hunger restored to the user per sole per second.
highwaystar.configuration.highwaystar.ma: Maximum number of soles spawned when splitting. No upper limit.
highwaystar.configuration.highwaystar.tr: Maximum tracking time in ticks (20 ticks = 1 second). Soles will return after this time even if the target is alive.
